title: Filmmaking
description: An AI short-film crew, bound to no one's generation models. The Director sets the direction, acts as gatekeeper, and asks for your sign-off at the brief, the script, the style, the lead cast, the finals and the finished film. The Screenwriter, Art Director, and Storyboard Artist turn the story step by step into shots that can be generated; for the leads, the Art Director produces candidate looks for you to choose from. The Cinematographer generates the film shot by shot. The Editor first assembles an animatic, then cuts the finished film. Images and video come from the models you choose: give the generating roles a tool server or a skill for them, and say so in the brief; for Volcengine Ark, use the "Volcengine Ark video" team as it is. Consistency across the film rests on the asset library: there is exactly one finalized version each of the characters, the style, and the shot list.

requires.install: Editing uses ffmpeg. Install it yourself (for example, brew install ffmpeg), or point to where it is installed.
